description: Presidential Secretariat - Order to amend the Gaz.Ex.No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 by inserting "2. Spices and Allied products Marketing Board" referring the Heading, Minister of Primary Industries
categorisation: This gazette content involves amendments to a constitutional notification regarding ministerial portfolios, specifically focusing on legal modifications to the structure of government ministries. It references constitutional powers (Article 43(1)) and previous gazette publications, making it primarily about legal framework and regulatory matters rather than about specific personnel appointments or organizational changes without legal context.
